text:
Will Smith is 21, on a four-game point streak, and part of the line San Jose Hockey Now called "Kids Are Alright": Smith, Macklin Celebrini and Ivar Stenberg combined for eight points in the 4-2 win over Nashville on Nov. 15, with Smith taking three of them. He has 19 points in 24 games, playing almost 20 minutes a night.

His own chances are strong: 9.16 expected goals (the quality of his looks), more than his eight goals, so there is no luck propping him up. If anything, his linemates have finished 3.7 goals below their chances with him on the ice. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking from last season puts him in the 98th percentile for scoring chances from the home-plate area in front of the net.

The open question is defense. Evolving-Hockey had opponents getting more chances with him out there last season, bottom 8% of forwards. Among forwards picked second to sixth since 2005, the median first full season was 0.47 points a game. He is at 0.79. The arc is pointing the right way.
headline: Will Smith and the kids' line in San Jose
